user.title: Activate MAIKA
user.description: Device code: **{activation_code}**. [Choose a plan or view your key]({portal_url}), paste the key below, then select Submit.

activation_pending.title: Waiting for approval
activation_pending.description: Device code: **{activation_code}**. Wait for seller approval, then select Submit.

account.title: Connect a MAIKA account
account.description: Enter a phone number or an email/Gmail address registered with MAIKA. Email login requires the MAIKA account password; Google Sign-In without a MAIKA password is not supported. Credentials are sent only to the MAIKA cloud, never to the activation server.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect MAIKA
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current MAIKA account credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the MAIKA cloud.
error.cannot_connect_license: Unable to connect to the activation server.
error.invalid_license_response: The activation server returned an invalid or unsigned license.
error.invalid_server_url: Enter a valid HTTPS activation server URL using a hostname.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid phone number, email, or password.
error.license_activation_limit: This license has reached its installation limit.
error.license_pending: The installation is still waiting for seller approval.
error.license_rejected: This device was rejected. Ask the seller to delete the device, then enter the key again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This MAIKA account is already configured.
abort.reauth_failed: The MAIKA config entry no longer exists.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The credentials belong to a different MAIKA account.

license_unavailable.message: MAIKA is not activated ({license_error}). Device code: {activation_code}. Open MAIKA → License to enter or replace your key. Choose a plan or view your key at {portal_url}.

maika_queue_unavailable.message: This MAIKA speaker is offline or no longer available in this integration.

maika_queue_refresh_failed.message: Unable to refresh the playlist on the MAIKA speaker. Try browsing it again.

maika_queue_invalid_selection.message: This song selection is invalid or is not in this speaker's playlist. Browse the MAIKA playlist and select a song again.

maika_queue_changed.message: The playlist on the MAIKA speaker has changed. Browse it again before selecting a song.

maika_queue_unsupported_mode.message: MAIKA playlist selection only jumps to an existing song; enqueue=add and enqueue=next are not supported.

maika_queue_jump_failed.message: MAIKA did not accept the request to select this song.

maika_content_store_failed.message: Unable to load the MAIKA entertainment library. Check the connection and try browsing again.

maika_content_store_invalid_selection.message: This entertainment library item is invalid. Browse the MAIKA library and select an item again.

maika_favorites_unavailable.message: No MAIKA favorites playlist is available. Sign in with a MAIKA account that has favorites.

maika_favorites_failed.message: Unable to load favorite songs from MAIKA. Check the connection and try again.

nhaccuatui_failed.message: Unable to load this NhacCuaTui song. Check the connection and try again.

nhaccuatui_track_unavailable.message: This NhacCuaTui song has no public stream available for playback.

nhaccuatui_invalid_track.message: This NhacCuaTui song key is invalid.

cloud_cast_disabled.message: Cloud audio casting is disabled. Open the MAIKA panel → Speaker settings to enable it.

cloud_cast_failed.message: MAIKA cloud did not accept the audio cast request.

cloud_cast_invalid_url.message: MAIKA cloud cast requires a valid HTTP(S) URL without embedded username or password.

cloud_cast_unsupported_media.message: MAIKA cloud cast supports MP3/MPEG and MP4/AAC audio or a generic music/audio URL, not {media_type}.

cloud_cast_unsupported_mode.message: MAIKA cloud cast does not support enqueue=add or enqueue=next.

cloud_cast_invalid_seek_position.message: The seek position must be a finite number of seconds.

cloud_cast_seek_unavailable.message: MAIKA can only seek the track it is currently casting from Home Assistant. Start a cloud cast, then drag the position slider.

maika_service_entry_not_found.message: The selected MAIKA account is not loaded. Check the integration entry and try again.

maika_service_device_required.message: Select one MAIKA speaker with a device target, serial_number, or entry_id.

maika_service_device_unknown.message: The selected MAIKA speaker is not loaded in this integration.

maika_service_device_multiple.message: The service matches more than one MAIKA speaker. Use a device target or pass entry_id and serial_number.

maika_service_reminder_failed.message: MAIKA cloud did not accept the reminder request. Check the connection and try again.

maika_service_reminder_not_found.message: The reminder does not exist on the selected MAIKA speaker.

maika_service_invalid_mute_days.message: mute_days must contain valid dates in YYYY-MM-DD format.
